messages:
violet: Quick design note — proposing per-lane autoscroll behavior for schema lanes in Run History. By default autoscroll on new items, but pause if the user has keyboard focus or a text selection. Mock: figma.com/s/autoscroll omar: Strong +1 on pausing. Auto-scroll is great for passive watching but it ruins keyboard navigation and copy-to-clipboard flows. Suggest a small toggle in header: 'Auto-scroll' (on/off). lee: Thought about reordering lanes via drag handle. Need keyboard equivalents: allow Ctrl+Left/Ctrl+Right to move lane positions. Use aria-grabbed or aria-dropeffect? Which is current best practice? sam: Copy action notes: header Copy JSON should trigger a status toast: "JSON copied to clipboard" with role="status" so SRs announce it. Also offer Download JSON as alternative. Keyboard shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C. rachel: NVDA/VoiceOver report: frequent aria-live updates (streaming chunks) are noisy. Recommend aria-live="polite" but only announce the finalization string. For streaming lines mark them aria-hidden="true" until finalization, then reveal. violet: Nice. So flows: Append visually during stream but keep those fragments aria-hidden. When final chunk arrives, unhide final output and fire single polite announcement: "Tool result complete for ". Also if user has focus/selection, never autoscroll — show a tiny "New" pill at bottom. omar: Implementation note: per-lane Auto-scroll toggle should be persisted per-session. Also add a global user preference in Settings > Run History. Keep label concise for i18n. lee: For drag + keyboard reorder: implement drag handle in header with aria-label="Reorder lane". Keyboard reordering: focus handle, then use Ctrl+Arrow to move; announce: "Lane moved left/right" via live region. Avoid using aria-grabbed; instead use roving tabindex + live announcements. sam: UI copy suggestions: header compact variants: "fetchProfile() · structured · 120ms", or "fetchProfile() · 120ms" with a small [Structured] pill. For the Auto-scroll toggle short label: "Auto-scroll" / "Autoscroll" — test translations (DE/JA get long). rachel: Also contrast check: type pill [Structured] needs sufficient contrast at small sizes. Provide 4.5:1 min AA for text or use icon+label for small pills. violet: Quick ARIA snippet I will attach to Figma notes: ```html fetchProfile() · structured · 120ms
``` lee: That looks good. For reorder keyboard example: focus handle then Ctrl+ArrowLeft to move. Add an e2e asserting announcement text. sam: Tests: add clipboard toast assertion and a test that autoscroll respects focus/selection. Also test keyboard reordering announcement. rachel: I'll run a short SR session focusing on: autoscroll toggle, copy toast, and finalization announcement. Report back if NVDA still speaks intermediate fragments. a11y-bot: Checklist: per-lane auto-scroll toggle + global pref; pause autoscroll when focus/selection present; streaming fragments aria-hidden then reveal on finalization; single polite announcement on complete; copy/download actions with role=status toast; keyboard reorder (Ctrl+Arrow) + live announcement; pill contrast check; i18n length review for button labels.
